# AgriSignal (`v1.1.0`)

> Offline-first smallholder agricultural decision support, explainable crop advisories, IPM pest-risk matrix, <=160-char EN/LG/SW SMS formatter, and LWW-Element-Set CRDT sync engine for East Africa.

- Website: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agrisignal/
- Field Studio: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agrisignal/studio.html
- Sync Proof: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agrisignal/proof.html
- Agro & IPM Rules: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agrisignal/rules.html
- Documentation: https://codesphere-u.github.io/agrisignal/docs.html
- Repository: https://github.com/codesphere-u/agrisignal
